title: Add interactive demos to core schemas, blocks, and plugin documentation
body:
Documentation pages for core schemas, blocks, and several plugins lacked live interactive demos, making it hard for customers to evaluate platform capabilities at a glance.

### Changes

**Core schema docs** — added demos to pages that had zero interactive examples:
- `theme-schema.mdx` — color palette preview, theme-aware component showcase
- `enhanced-actions.mdx` — action buttons, confirmation dialog, action toolbar
- `app-schema.mdx` — sidebar navigation, application header bar
- `report-schema.mdx` — KPI header, data breakdown table, schedule config

**Blocks docs:**
- `blocks/index.mdx` — quick preview gallery (stats card, login card, notification)
- `block-schema.mdx` — feature card, variable overrides, marketplace listing

**Plugin docs** — enhanced pages with few or no working demos:
- `plugin-view.mdx` — grid/detail/form views (was 0 demos)
- `plugin-dashboard.mdx` — e-commerce + support dashboards (was 1 demo)
- `plugin-grid.mdx` — 2 working demos replacing commented-out broken ones
- `plugin-form.mdx` — contact form with mixed field types
- `plugin-calendar.mdx` — week view with time slots

**Bug fixes:**
- Replaced `table` component in demos with layout-based rows to avoid `useSchemaContext` errors (grid plugin requires `SchemaRendererProvider` not available in doc site demos)
- Normalized icon names to kebab-case (`BarChart3` → `chart-column`, `CheckCircle` → `circle-check`, etc.) per codebase convention
